title: Large Language Models as Urban Residents: An LLM Agent Framework for Personal Mobility Generation
journal: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 37
authors: Jiawei Wang; Renhe Jiang; Chuang Yang; Zengqing Wu; Makoto Onizuka; Ryosuke Shibasaki; Noboru Koshizuka; Chuan Xiao
abstract: This paper introduces a novel approach using Large Language Models (LLMs) integrated into an agent framework for flexible and effective personal mobility generation. LLMs overcome the limitations of previous models by effectively processing semantic data and offering versatility in modeling various tasks. Our approach addresses three research questions: aligning LLMs with real-world urban mobility data, developing reliable activity generation strategies, and exploring LLM applications in urban mobility. The key technical contribution is a novel LLM agent framework that accounts for individual activity patterns and motivations, including a self-consistency approach to align LLMs with real-world activity data and a retrieval-augmented strategy for interpretable activity generation. We evaluate our LLM agent framework and compare it with state-of-the-art personal mobility generation approaches, demonstrating the effectiveness of our approach and its potential applications in urban mobility. Overall, this study marks the pioneering work of designing an LLM agent framework for activity generation based on real world human activity data, offering a promising tool for urban mobility analysis. Source codes are available at https://github.com/Wangjw6/LLMob/ .
abstractZh: 本文提出将大语言模型（LLM）集成到智能体框架的新方法，以灵活、有效地生成个人移动。LLM能够有效处理语义数据，并灵活建模不同任务，从而克服以往模型的局限。该方法围绕三个研究问题展开：如何使LLM与真实城市移动数据对齐、如何建立可靠的活动生成策略，以及LLM在城市移动中的应用。核心技术贡献是一个考虑个体活动模式与动机的新型LLM智能体框架，包括将LLM与真实活动数据对齐的自一致性方法，以及支持可解释活动生成的检索增强策略。我们评估该框架，并与最先进的个人移动生成方法比较，展示方法的有效性及其在城市移动中的潜在应用。总体而言，本研究率先设计了基于真实人类活动数据的活动生成LLM智能体框架，为城市移动分析提供有前景的工具。源代码公开于https://github.com/Wangjw6/LLMob/ 。
